newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active in Kansas on Tuesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were $2.00 higher than last week. Inquiry and demand good.

Sales confirmed on 30,800 slaughter steers and 30,400 slaughter heifers Tuesday. For the week to date 82,600 head confirmed including 29,300 head or about 35 percent of previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Slaughter Steers Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1300 lbs 66.00, few 65.00-65.50; few Select and Choice 1250-1300 lb Holsteins 60.00. Dressed Basis Select and Choice 2-3 1175-1275 lbs 105.00-105.50.
Slaughter Heifers Select and Choice 2-3 1025-1190 lbs 66.00, few 65.50-65.75; pen 975 lbs 65.00; mixed Commercial to Choice 1250-1350 lb heifers and heiferettes 64.00-65.00.
Dressed Basis Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1125 lbs 105.00-106.00.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
